baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا ... وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ... هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Exhaustive communal plurality is paired with an appointed, repeatedly enacted rite, while invitation to one Lord and straight guidance provide a common bearing. The forms can differ without making their Lordward orientation plural.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing totality makes the allocation cover every community rather than a favored exception.
A group gathered by a common feature supplies the distinct communal units receiving rites.
Community as a followed way lets the people and their practiced pattern remain semantically intertwined.
Causing something to occupy a condition frames the rite as an assigned ordering, not an accidental custom.
The place and work of devotion give mansak both a concrete setting and an enacted procedure.
Persistence on a way makes the noun-agent repetition describe a community inhabiting its practice.
Calling that inclines through speech supplies a noncoercive motion toward the Lord.
Gentle indication toward road and truth gives the diverse practices a shared directional criterion.
Straightness, balance, and evenness characterize the bearing on which the addressee stands.

changed_reading.before: Each community simply possesses a different ritual.
changed_reading.after: The ayah coordinates exhaustive plurality of enacted communal forms with one Lordward direction; difference of mansak need not equal difference of ultimate bearing.

baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated N-S-K root can specify an appointed sacrificial offering and also the place or performance in which it occurs. The community is therefore not merely assigned a belief but cast as the active performer of a material rite.

activation_trace.role: Appointment into a condition makes the sacrificial procedure an instituted communal form.
The قربان animal and poured blood supply the concrete sacrificial possibility of mansak.
Place and performance keep sacrifice from shrinking to the victim alone; it is a situated rite.

changed_reading.before: Mansak is an unspecified style of worship.
changed_reading.after: Mansak can be heard concretely as an appointed sacrificial performance whose community repeatedly enacts it in a designated ritual setting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ... رَبِّكَ ... هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: N-S-K carries washing, purification of an ingot, and persistence on a way. Joined to the Lord's nurturing completion and an even course, the community-specific mansak can function as a repeated technology of formation: practice removes admixture and trains a stable direction.

activation_trace.role: Washing and purification supply the cleansing operation latent in ritual performance.
A silver ingot cleared of dross gives the practice a material image of refinement.
Continued use of a way turns purification from a moment into a formative habit.
Repair, nurture, and completion assign the Lord the formative endpoint of the practice.
Course, manner, and intended direction convert refinement into a traversable orientation.
Evenness and rectitude name the stable condition produced by the repeated practice.

changed_reading.before: The rite marks communal identity externally.
changed_reading.after: The rite may also be a community-specific refinery: repeated embodied practice cleans, forms, and stabilizes its practitioners on a Lordward course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَلَا يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual pulling makes dispute a struggle to seize the addressee's position. Because amr can be affair, binding command, authority, or deliberated policy, several disputes coexist: over the rite itself, over who commands it, and over who controls the frame of deliberation. The answering motion is invitation rather than counter-pulling.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal tugging gives controversy a two-sided struggle for control rather than mere verbal difference.
Affair or condition preserves the broad reading that the contested object is the ritual matter.
Authority and its holder activate a jurisdictional reading of what the parties are pulling over.
Consultation and management of opinion activate competition over the terms of deliberation.
Speech that calls and inclines replaces reciprocal seizure with an open directional appeal.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the authority to whom the disputed matter is redirected.

changed_reading.before: The prophet is told only to win or avoid an argument about ritual law.
changed_reading.after: He is told not to be pulled into a contest for ownership of the affair, command, or forum; his distinct action is to keep directing speech toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim formula in 22:34 explicitly places mansak over provision from livestock and the naming of God; 22:36 identifies dedicated animal bodies, while 22:37 denies that flesh is the thing that reaches God and closes with guidance. This strongly concretizes sacrifice while relocating its efficacy from material transfer to God-conscious orientation.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch anchors mansak in a قربان animal and poured blood.
The repeated mansak formula activates the sacrificial branch beside livestock provision and naming God.
Divine uniqueness makes varied communal sacrificial forms converge in the worship of one God.
The dedicated offering animal supplies the concrete body used in the rite.
Literal flesh marks the material component that the verse explicitly denies as the rite's divine endpoint.
Gentle direction to road and truth supplies the nonmaterial telos named after the sacrificial correction.

structural_cues: 22:34 repeats 'for every community We appointed a mansak' before explaining remembrance over provided livestock.
22:36 moves from appointed ritual to dedicated bodies, naming, falling sides, eating, and feeding.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with taqwa, then links magnification to prior guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula and the livestock-body-flesh-guidance sequence; I infer that 22:34 glosses the focus mansak and that 22:37 makes ethical orientation, not material delivery, its endpoint. A live alternative is that sacrifice is one salient instance without exhausting the broader place, practice, and habitual-way senses of mansak.

changed_reading.before: Sacrifice is only one dictionary possibility among many for mansak.
changed_reading.after: The surah strongly activates an actual communal sacrifice, yet defines its success through naming, sharing, taqwa, and guidance rather than flesh or blood reaching God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The house sequence orders purification, circumambulation, public summons, travel through open mountain passes, completion of obligations, and renewed circumambulation. That sequence activates mansak as a situated itinerary whose coherent orientation includes both straight travel and circular movement.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch of ritual place and work anchors the itinerary in mansak itself.
Straightness and evenness provide the stable orientation against which the route's varied motions are read.
Removal of impurity prepares the house as the itinerary's usable ritual center.
Rotation around a thing supplies a directed circular action within the rite.
Intentional travel toward what is magnified gives the dispersed travelers one destination.
Wide passes between mountains materialize the converging approach routes.
Completion and finishing mark the itinerary as an ordered sequence with closure.
Established antiquity gives the house temporal depth as the route's enduring center.

structural_cues: 22:26-29 forms a procedural chain from preparing the house to movement, arrival, benefits, sacrifice, completion, and return around the house.
22:27 combines linear arrival from every deep pass with 22:26 and 22:29's circular movement around one center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered set of places and actions around the house; I infer that this sequence operationally expands the focus sense of 'place and work of ritual' and that straight guidance denotes coherent bearing rather than geometrically straight motion. The live alternative is that the focus mansak is narrower, especially sacrificial, while the itinerary is only its surrounding frame.

changed_reading.before: Mansak is a single ritual slot or isolated act.
changed_reading.after: Mansak can organize a whole pilgrimage itinerary: approach, preparation, circling, sacrifice, completion, and return all hold together under one stable orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence in 22:52-54 moves from intrusive casting, through removal and firming, to hearts becoming low and settled, and finally to a straight path. It turns the focus contrast between reciprocal pulling and straight guidance into a dynamic stabilization process rather than a static claim of correctness.

activation_trace.role: Mutual pulling anchors the focus danger as destabilizing contest.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive insertion that disturbs proclamation.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the corrective clearing of the intrusion.
Making firm, exact, and secure supplies the stabilization after removal.
A low, tranquil expanse gives believing hearts a settled receptive posture.
The dying down of fire supplies a coexisting image of agitation subsiding in the heart.
Gentle indication toward the road names the positive motion after interference is cleared.
Rectitude and balance name the path's stabilized condition.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, removal, and firming rather than presenting revelation as untouched by attempted interference.
22:53-54 contrasts diseased or hardened hearts with knowing, believing, humbled hearts before repeating straight-path language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the interference-correction-settlement-guidance sequence; I infer that the focus prohibition on being pulled into dispute protects the same kind of directional stability and that invitation continues after noise is cleared. A live alternative is that 22:52-54 concerns revelation generally and should not be made a direct explanation of ritual controversy.

changed_reading.before: Being upon straight guidance is a static credential asserted against opponents.
changed_reading.after: Straight guidance is also a recoverable stability: intrusive material is removed, what is true is made firm, hearts settle, and the call can retain its direction despite contest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation distinguishes opponents' argument from the addressee's required response: answer with God's knowledge, then leave divergent paths to God's judgment at the resurrection. The prohibition therefore limits capture by reciprocal controversy; it does not claim that disagreement will cease.

activation_trace.role: Two-sided pulling supplies the mode of controversy from which the addressee is kept.
Authority and sovereignty make the destination of final adjudication a live issue in the focus.
Twisted, entangled disputation names the opponents' continuing argumentative action.
Judgment between people transfers final settlement away from the present contestants.
Resurrection supplies the deferred temporal forum for final judgment.
Each taking a path unlike the other's preserves real divergence until that judgment.

structural_cues: 22:68 begins conditionally with continued argument and gives a restrained knowledge formula as the reply.
22:69 places judgment over their differences on the day of resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate sequence from 'do not let them pull you' to 'if they argue' and then divine judgment; I infer that the first command governs the prophet's participation, not the opponents' ability to speak. A live alternative is that the prohibition also authorizes firm present rebuttal, but the supplied reply still withholds final adjudication.

changed_reading.before: The command demands suppression or immediate resolution of ritual disagreement.
changed_reading.after: The command establishes procedural restraint: continue the Lordward invitation, answer argument without entering its tug-of-war, and defer final settlement of persistent divergence to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing commands spread devotion across bowing, prostration, worship, strenuous exertion, inherited way, regular prayer, and holding fast, while explicitly denying constriction in religion. This strengthens the habitual N-S-K reading: mansak is not only an event but an embodied communal discipline that forms continuity without being defined by oppressive narrowness.

activation_trace.role: Persistence on a way anchors the focus rite as a repeated communal discipline.
Bending and lowering the head supply one recurrent bodily articulation of the way.
Lowering oneself in submission deepens the discipline's embodied humility.
Worship as submissive obedience expands the rite beyond one isolated gesture.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies sustained effort within the communal way.
Obedience and yielding name the wider religious field in which ritual practice operates.
Narrowness and constriction identify what the appointed discipline explicitly is not meant to impose.
A followed religious way connects the present discipline to Abrahamic inheritance.
A road made recognizable by repeated travel materially reinforces inherited habitual continuity.
A preserving hold supplies cohesion and protection at the discipline's close.

structural_cues: 22:77 stacks bodily worship commands with doing good rather than isolating one ceremony.
22:78 joins effort, divine choosing, absence of constriction, Abrahamic inheritance, communal naming, witness, prayer, almsgiving, and holding fast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing network of repeated bodily and communal practices plus inherited way and non-constriction; I infer that it displays what sustained communal nasak can do across a life. A live alternative is to reserve mansak for the sacrificial or pilgrimage rite and treat the closing discipline as its ethical aftermath rather than its semantic expansion.

changed_reading.before: Mansak is a bounded ceremony that distinguishes one community from another.
changed_reading.after: Mansak can participate in a wider embodied discipline: repeated submission, effort, inherited continuity, social obligation, and protective attachment form a people without making religion a constricted enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual in 22:40 makes divine repulsion of people by one another the condition preventing destruction of several differently named worship habitats, all joined by abundant naming of God. This activates an institutional reading of 'for every community a mansak': differentiated ritual habitats can coexist within a protected ecology rather than compete for erasure.

activation_trace.role: Communities as gathered groups anchor the focus plurality in social bodies.
Ritual place and work anchor the proposed link from community practice to worship habitat.
Turning away harm supplies the protective mechanism that keeps the plural sites from destruction.
The specifically Christian worship-site branch makes institutional difference concrete rather than generic.
Places and houses of prayer supply another distinct worship habitat in the protected list.
The second mapped inventory independently retains prayer places, preserving the split-root evidence.
A place of prostration adds the mosque as a differentiated ritual setting.
Remembrance running on the tongue supplies the common act linking the diverse sites.

structural_cues: 22:40 names multiple kinds of worship site in one destruction counterfactual.
The list closes by describing abundant mention of God's name within them rather than by erasing their distinct names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine protection, a plural institutional list, and a shared remembrance function; I infer that this is a social habitat in which the focus allocation of communal rites can coexist without mutual erasure. A live alternative is that 22:40 concerns historical protection of worship generally and does not itself authorize every community-specific rite.

changed_reading.before: Different communal rites are merely rival claims to be ranked in argument.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah also permits a protected ecology of differentiated worship forms and sites, joined by remembrance of God and bounded against destructive rivalry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant H-D-Y branches of gift and sanctuary offering beneath the ordinary focus noun 'guidance.' It remains anchored in the explicit N-S-K sacrificial branch and the focus H-D-Y inventory, but downstream prose must present it only as a semantic echo, never as a replacement translation of huda.

activation_trace.role: The قربان sacrifice supplies the material offering pole of the echo.
A gently dispatched gift to one held in affection lets guidance resonate as something graciously sent.
The offering sent to the sanctuary creates a form-distant return echo between sacrificial mansak and huda.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only abstract instruction appended after a material rite.
changed_reading.after: As a contained semantic resonance, divine guidance can sound like the gracious counter-gift that redirects sacrificial offering from material transfer toward a Lordward relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it makes the repeated posture 'upon' spatial and load-bearing rather than merely propositional. It remains anchored in the focus phrase 'upon straight guidance' and in 22:11's edge, settling, and face-overturning sequence, but it should be qualified as a structural analogy rather than a claim that the two verses are lexical glosses of one another.

activation_trace.role: A course with direction supplies the surface on which the addressee's stance is imagined.
Balance, evenness, and rectitude make that stance stable rather than marginal.
Inclination away from a direction activates the precarious edge-position contrasted with straight bearing.
Settling and tranquility provide the temporary stability that testing exposes as conditional.
Turning a thing over on its face materializes collapse when an edge-based stance loses support.

changed_reading.before: 'Upon straight guidance' only certifies that the addressee holds a correct proposition.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can also depict a tested, load-bearing stance: unlike worship from an edge that overturns under trial, straight guidance supports continued invitation under argumentative pull.

strongest_changes: The repeated 22:34 formula and 22:36-37 sequence strongly concretize mansak as sacrifice while relocating efficacy from flesh and blood to remembrance, sharing, taqwa, and guidance.
The pilgrimage sequence activates mansak as an ordered place-and-action itinerary in which straight orientation can include circular movement around a stable center.
The immediate 22:68-69 continuation changes the dispute command into procedural restraint and deferred divine adjudication, not suppression of disagreement.
The closing discipline and 22:40's protected worship sites preserve broader habitual and plural-institutional readings alongside the concrete sacrificial one.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sits at a convergence: an earlier near-duplicate supplies sacrificial content, an interference-to-guidance sequence makes straightness dynamic, and the immediate sequel assigns unresolved difference to divine judgment. The branch inventory also keeps purification, habitual formation, gift, and sanctuary-offering echoes alive without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether focus mansak should be restricted by 22:34 to sacrifice or allowed to retain the broader place, itinerary, and habitual-way senses.
Whether al-amr primarily names the ritual affair, divine command, jurisdiction, or the management of deliberation; the focus grammar supports coexistence more readily than selection.
How much interpretive weight to give the form-distant H-D-Y gift and sanctuary-offering branches beneath the ordinary reading of huda as guidance.
Whether the protected plurality of worship sites in 22:40 directly informs 'every community a mansak' or remains a looser social analogy.
